title: six is the third triangular number — a machine-checked theorem of the ℤ/9 vortex deposit
description:
six is the third triangular number, declared in src/proof/mechanical.lean and accepted by the Lean 4 kernel, sorry-free and axiom-free, closing by by decide.

Statement (Lean):

let t := ((List.range' 1 3).map (fun i => i)).foldl (fun x y => x + y) 0; t == 6

Statement (LaTeX):

t = 6 \quad \text{where } t = \operatorname{fold}_{x,\,y \mapsto x + y}\left(\{\, i \mid i \in \{1,\dots,3\} \,\},\, 0\right)

It is not a claim that the result is unknown to the literature: prior art for this file is recorded in src/proof/priorart.lean as unclassified — no prior-art search has been performed, so no novelty is asserted.

Scope. The declaration is decided over a finite domain by exhaustion. It settles no Clay Millennium Problem and claims no quantum speedup. 0/7.
